## The data portal is not live yet
Pangenome graphs and the SV-eQTL database will be released here as they pass quality control. [Follow the news](news/index.qmd) for release announcements.
:::

Data from the project goes to three places, depending on what it is and how identifiable it is.

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "Data sharing strategy. Summary-level resources are public; individual-level sequences are available through controlled access."
flowchart LR
  subgraph Data
    A[LatinPangenome graph]
    B[SV-eQTL and SNP-eQTL database]
    C[Single-cell gene counts]
    D[Individual-level genomes]
  end
  subgraph Host
    P[LatinGenomes web portal]
    Z[CZ CELLxGENE]
    E[European Genome-phenome Archive]
  end
  U[Your computer]
  A --> P
  B --> P
  C --> Z
  D --> E
  P -- open --> U
  Z -- open --> U
  E -- approved by the DAC --> U
```

## Open resources

**LatinPangenome graph and SV catalog.** Graph files and variant calls, downloadable from this site with documentation and versioning.

**eQTL database.** Browsable and downloadable associations for structural variants and SNPs across 29 cell types.

**Single-cell expression.** Gene count matrices through [CZ CELLxGENE](https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/), maintained by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

## Controlled access

Individual-level whole-genome sequences will be deposited in the [European Genome-phenome Archive](https://ega-archive.org/). Researchers apply through EGA, and requests are reviewed by a Data Access Committee of LatinGenomes researchers. The committee's role is to make sure uses are consistent with the consent participants gave and with the expectations of their communities.
